clips.title: The story
paras: Cultists in the Valley of Trials carry the Burning Blade Medallion. Yarrog Baneshadow holds it deep in the Burning Blade Coven, where its dark magic threatens Durotar's young warriors.

Zureetha Fargaze's divinations point to the medallion in the Burning Blade Coven. Yarrog Baneshadow, an agent of the Burning Blade cult, carries it deep inside the winding caverns. The trinket channels dark power among the cult's impish familiars and felstalkers. Defeating Yarrog and taking the medallion ends the cult's attempt to undermine the Horde's training grounds from within Durotar.
